title: The Missing Survey: A Team Learns to Check Its Data · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short report (about 120–150 words) for a school club. The club wants to start a weekend reading group. You asked 20 students, and 15 said yes. But you only asked students in one class. Write a report that: states the first result; explains why the data may be incomplete; suggests how to collect better data; and gives a final recommendation. Use at least two conditional sentences and two quantity words (e.g., a few, many, much, percent).
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
